class.name: RoadTrafficServer
class.brief_description: Road traffic around the camera, driven along the roads of [TrackServer].
class.description: Vehicles driven along the roads ([constant TrackServer.GROUP_ROAD]) the server is given ([method road_add_many]): no physics and no driver - a body keeping its distance to the one ahead, on the right of its road, taking a random way at a junction as the original's car does (Driver.cpp:660-690). A vehicle with nowhere to go at the end of its road - a dead end, the edge of the roads given - is taken off. The vehicles are a fleet built once, from [method traffic_set_vehicle_types] and the [code]maszyna/traffic/max_vehicles[/code] setting: an instance's materials are made on the main thread, so none is built while the traffic runs - a vehicle taken off waits hidden for its next road. A road near the camera holds vehicles by its length, the [code]maszyna/traffic/density[/code] setting, the heat map ([method traffic_set_density_noise]), its width and the time of day ([method traffic_set_time_of_day_curve]). The traffic moves with the simulation's clock ([signal SimulationServer.simulation_advanced]) and stands while the simulation is paused.

method.name: road_add_many
method.description: Roads of [TrackServer] to drive on, connected to the roads given before where their ends meet; the tracks of another group and the unpaved roads - gripping less than an asphalt road ([method TrackServer.track_get_friction] below 0.7, a road of the default friction counting as paved) - are passed over. The roads near the camera are filled with vehicles at once.

method.name: road_remove_many
method.description: Roads no longer driven on, before they are freed: their vehicles go back to the fleet.

method.name: traffic_set_density_noise
method.description: The heat map: a road's traffic grows with the noise where its middle is. Without one every road is as busy as its length and width make it.

method.name: traffic_set_scenario
method.description: Where the fleet is drawn; an empty RID takes it out of every scenario.

method.name: traffic_set_time_of_day_curve
method.description: The density's multiplier by the hours of the day: the curve's domain is 0-24.

method.name: traffic_set_vehicle_types
method.description: The kinds of vehicles the fleet is drawn from, by their weights; the fleet is built again from them.

method.name: vehicle_get_track
method.description: The road the vehicle is on; an empty RID while it waits in the fleet.

method.name: vehicle_get_transform
method.description: Where the vehicle stands, in the frame its model is authored in: +Z the way it goes, +X its left.
